body_markdown:
*Six acclaimed bars from Tokyo, Mumbai, Manila, Los Angeles and Hong Kong come together at Wynn Palace, alongside a special UNITY Session, for two nights exploring how the world celebrates the festive season*


**Macao, November 26, 2026 –** Wing Lei Bar & Friends closes its year-long, four-part series with a celebration. On December 11–12, Volume 4 brings six acclaimed bars from Tokyo, Mumbai, Manila, Los Angeles and Hong Kong to Wing Lei Bar at Wynn Palace for two festive nights of guest shifts inspired by holiday traditions from around the world.


**A Year of UNITY**


Over the past year, **Wing Lei Bar & Friends** has brought more than 150 guest bartenders to Macao, connecting Wing Lei Bar with the international bar community through guest shifts, collaboration and creative exchange. The Festive Edition brings this year-long series to a fitting close, exploring how different cultures celebrate the year-end season, from distinctive traditions, flavors and rituals to the drinks raised in celebration. Each guest bar will bring three cocktails to Macao: two signature cocktails and one special festive creation inspired by celebrations in its home city.


**Friday, December 11 – Lights Up!**


The festivities begin at 8pm with the **UNITY Session** led by Wing Lei Bar's Director of Bars Mark Lloyd. Alongside selections from his UNITY II cocktail menu, Mark will present a festive cocktail created especially for the night: Atholl Brose. Inspired by the traditional Scottish Highland drink and dessert of the same name, Mark reworks it as a stirred cocktail with Monkey Shoulder, St-Germain, crème de mûre and orange bitters, finished with a blackberry honey and oat milk foam.


From 10pm until midnight, **The Bar at The Ritz-Carlton, Tokyo** (No.75 on The 50 Bars Asia 2026) joins Mumbai's **Late Checkout** . From Tokyo, head bartender **Kentaro Wada** draws on his expertise and Japanese ingredients to create cocktails that showcase local craftsmanship and capture the city's unique character. Representing Mumbai is **Nikhil Kamble** , Head Bartender at Late Checkout, whose approach combines storytelling and innovation with the heartfelt hospitality of an owner-driven boutique hotel bar.


**Saturday, December 12 – Cocktail Wonderland**


The second night opens at 8pm as Manila's **Fat Cat** pairs with Los Angeles' **Night on Earth** . From Manila, **Ron Cruz** brings Fat Cat's community-driven approach and home-like comfort, where music, conversation and personal connection come first. Joining him from Los Angeles is **Tom Liu** of Night on Earth, **** the brand-new sister bar of Thunderbolt (No.92 on The 50 Bars North America 2026). Tom takes a science-led approach to cocktail making, creating tech-forward and zero-waste drinks through pre-batching, precise temperature control, clarification and carbonation.


From 10pm until midnight, the weekend closes closer to home with Hong Kong's **Argo** (No.25 on The 50 Bars 2026) and **Montana** (No.36 on The 50 Bars 2026) sharing the counter. Representing Argo is **Jonathan Gabbay** , Beverage Manager at Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong, whose program balances respect for the classics with the energy of Hong Kong, blending creativity, precision and storytelling into drinks that are innovative yet approachable. Joining him is Montana's Bar Manager **Mike Tse** . Named after a forgotten 1930s Cuban daiquiri, Montana's drinks program pairs faithful Cuban classics with playful tropical twists.


**Completing the Collection**


The series' signature collectible sticker campaign returns for its final chapter of the year. Each guest bartender will be featured on their own personalized, limited-edition sticker – this time in a special festive edition – giving collectors who have followed Wing Lei Bar & Friends throughout the year one final opportunity to complete their sticker books.


Wing Lei Bar & Friends Vol. 4: Festive Edition takes place at Wing Lei Bar, Wynn Palace, on December 11–12, 2026.
